text: RESULTS: Atrophy of the caudate nuclei with ex vacuo dilatation of the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles.

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI findings of caudate atrophy, combined with your history of progressive motor symptoms, psychiatric changes like hearing voices, and difficulty speaking, are classic for Huntington's disease. DIAGNOSIS READY: Huntington's disease
